{"claims":[{"claim_text":"We do not pretend to know exactly how a transition from capitalism to socialism will ultimately play out.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"We want to build a socialist party that can take advantage of a crisis of legitimacy of capitalism when it surely arrives.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"A party can help foment a crisis through helping to build powerful movements from below, including strikes, workplace takeovers, student occupations, and mass demonstrations.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Electing a socialist government can help foment a crisis.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Such mobilizations and such a government would together be able to create a rupture with the capitalist system.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"In a transitional period, a socialist government backed by popular mobilizations will have to do everything necessary to defend the mandate they have won to carry out a program of redistribution.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"In a transitional period, a socialist government backed by popular mobilizations will have to do everything necessary to defend the mandate they have won to carry out a program of expropriation.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"In a transitional period, a socialist government backed by popular mobilizations will have to do everything necessary to defend the mandate they have won to carry out a program of democratic reform of state institutions.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"No ruling class has ever peacefully ceded power.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
